note: The brob box payload is input-controlled; its first four bytes choose the decompressed BMFF payload type while the remaining bytes are compressed data passed onward.
The input-controlled bytes after the brob realType field are provided as the Brotli compressed stream for decompression into arr.
The output buffer capacity is guessed from compressed size rather than from the actual decoded size required by the Brotli stream.
The guessed length is used to size the DataBuf that will receive bytes emitted by the Brotli decoder.
The remaining writable space passed to Brotli is computed from the guessed allocation and current decoded byte count.
The Brotli output pointer is positioned in the DataBuf at the current decoded offset.
The decoder writes decompressed bytes to next_out using the undersized remaining output space, reaching the container-overflow write reported in Brotli.
